changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE daily_login_pass_claims ( id INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, account_id INT NOT NULL, character_id INT NOT NULL, campaign_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, reward_day TINYINT NOT NULL, claimed_on DATE NOT NULL, reward_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, reward_amount INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, claimed_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY uq_daily_login_pass_account_day (account_id, campaign_key, reward_day), UNIQUE KEY uq_daily_login_pass_account_date (account_id, campaign_key, claimed_on), INDEX idx_daily_login_pass_account_campaign (account_id, campaign_key), CONSTRAINT fk_daily_login_pass_account FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT fk_daily_login_pass_character FOREIGN KEY (character_id) REFERENCES characters (id) ON DELETE CASCADE );
